meta.title: MOSAIC.KZ — natural stone mosaic, laid by hand in Almaty
meta.description: Marble, onyx and travertine mosaic in the patterns of the steppe. Laid by hand in Almaty, delivered across Kazakhstan. Order on WhatsApp.

material.copy: No two sheets of stone are alike. We match them by hand so the wall reads as one whole.

split.title: From block to piece
split.copy: The block is cut into slabs, the slabs into 8–10 mm chips. Each chip is honed and set on mesh by hand.

collections.title: Five ways to build a wall

order.title: Three steps

steps.d: A collection and a stone. Not sure? Send us a photo of the room.
Your area in the estimator. We add 10% for cutting.
Us on WhatsApp. We reply within an hour with an invoice.
